metadata.name: GetLoyaltyRuleonAccount
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to return all the Loyalty Rules which are either applicable to the account( i.e via which Account can earn rewards) or which are already applied to the account( i.e via which account is already earnning rewards).

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/CardNumber/AccountNumber/AccountID is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtain by admin number (Embossing Acct-id) Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/CardNumber/AccountNumber/AccountID is required.

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of account holder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896541236 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/CardNumber/AccountNumber/AccountID is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: DecisionFlag
request_fields.description: This flag decide if loyalty rules applicable to the account should return or the already applied rules should return. Valid Values: 1 = Applied Rule on Accounts 2 = Applicable Rule on Accounts 3 = Both(Applied and Applicable) rule on Account. 4 = Expired Rule on Accounts Example:3

request_fields.name: StartDate
request_fields.description: StartDate(Activities will be fetched from given date). If not provided then default start date is Account Creation Date. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

request_fields.name: EndDate
request_fields.description: EndDate(Activities will be fetched from given date). If not provided then default End date is Current Date. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of cardholder. Allowable Values: 19

children.name: AppliedRuleDetails
children.description: Applied RuleDetails

children.name: ApplicableRuleDetails
children.description: Applicable RuleDetails

children.name: ExpiredRuleDetails
children.description: Expired RuleDetails

children.name: RuleID
children.description: ID of LoyaltyRule. Valid Values: 0-9(Value provided by Corecard) Example:1234

children.name: RuleName
children.description: Name of the Loyalty Rule. Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: Base Rule

children.name: RuleDescription
children.description: Name of the Loyalty Rule. Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: Base Rule

children.name: RuleType
children.description: Flag to decide the type of Loyalty Rule. Possible Values : 0:Base 1:Promotional 2:Advance Promotional 3:Exclusion Example:1

children.name: RuleApplication
children.description: Type of transaction on which the Loyalty rule should trigger for the Account. Example : Purchase

children.name: RuleSetupOn
children.description: Addtional criteria on which Loyalty rule should trigger for the Account. Example : None

children.name: RuleStatus
children.description: Status of Loyalty Rule. Example: Active

children.name: StartDate
children.description: Start Date of Loyalty Program.

children.name: EndDate
children.description: End Date of Loyalty Program

children.name: RewardPercent
children.description: Reflect the percent of the loyalty transaction.

children.name: RewardAmountPoints
children.description: Reflect the flat rewards points

children.name: TotalAmountSpent
children.description: This column will show the total amount the account has spent Valid Values: 0-9 Example - 450.00

children.name: NumberofTransaction
children.description: This will show the number of Tranact Valid Values: 0-9 Example - 6

children.name: RewardGenerateOn
children.description: Date on which the applied rule is applicable to provide to reward. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:mm:ss Example - 02/04/2021

children.name: NumberofGoodPaymentsRequired
children.description: This tag will show number of consecutive good payments required to earn the reward. Valid Values: 0-9 Example - 6

children.name: NumberofGoodPaymentsMade
children.description: This tag will show number of consecutive good payments made by the customer to earn the reward. Valid Values: 0-9 Example - 3
